LuaScript:
-- UNO Classic for TTS

SETTINGS = {
    debug = false,
    existing_draw_guid = nil,
    player_order = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Yellow", "Orange", "Purple", "White", "Brown", "Pink", "Teal" },
    draw_pos = { x = 0, y = 1.2, z = -2.2 },
    discard_pos = { x = 0, y = 1.2, z = 2.2 },
    discard_radius = 2.4,
    discard_step = 0.02,
    back = "https://dummyimage.com/750x1050/111111/ffffff.png&text=UNO",
}

STATE = {
    active = false,
    winner = nil,
    players = {},
    idx = {},
    dir = 1,
    turn = nil,
    turn_no = 0,
    draw_guid = nil,
    top_guid = nil,
    top_color = nil,
    top_type = nil,
    top_value = nil,
    discard_n = 0,
    awaiting_color = nil,
    pending_w4 = nil,
    pending_uno = {},
    catch_window = nil,
    drew = false,
}

function onLoad()
    -- Keep load path minimal/safe. UI buttons can be added later after core load is stable.
end

function setupButtons()
    local ui_host = getUiHost()
    if not ui_host then
        error("no UI host object available for createButton")
    end
    ui_host.clearButtons()
    mkBtn(ui_host, "btnStart", "Start UNO Round", {-6,0.3,0.0}, 2800)
    mkBtn(ui_host, "btnUno", "UNO", {-6,0.3,1.0}, 1200)
    mkBtn(ui_host, "btnChallenge", "Challenge +4", {-6,0.3,1.8}, 2200)
    mkBtn(ui_host, "btnAccept", "Accept +4", {-6,0.3,2.6}, 1600)
    mkBtn(ui_host, "btnDraw", "Draw", {-6,0.3,3.4}, 1200)
    mkBtn(ui_host, "btnColorRed", "Red", {6,0.3,-1.8}, 1200)
    mkBtn(ui_host, "btnColorYellow", "Yellow", {6,0.3,-1.0}, 1200)
    mkBtn(ui_host, "btnColorGreen", "Green", {6,0.3,-0.2}, 1200)
    mkBtn(ui_host, "btnColorBlue", "Blue", {6,0.3,0.6}, 1200)
end

function getUiHost()
    if self and self.createButton then
        return self
    end
    if Global and Global.createButton then
        return Global
    end
    return nil
end

function mkBtn(ui_host, fn, label, pos, width)
    ui_host.createButton({
        click_function = fn,
        function_owner = ui_host,
        label = label,
        position = pos,
        width = width,
        height = 420,
        font_size = 220,
        color = {0.15,0.15,0.15,0.95},
        font_color = {1,1,1,1},
    })
end

function btnStart(_, color) if isHost(color) then startRound(color) end end
function btnUno(_, color) callUno(color) end
function btnChallenge(_, color) challengeW4(color) end
function btnAccept(_, color) acceptW4(color) end
function btnDraw(_, color) drawAction(color) end
function btnColorRed(_, c) chooseColor(c, "Red") end
function btnColorYellow(_, c) chooseColor(c, "Yellow") end
function btnColorGreen(_, c) chooseColor(c, "Green") end
function btnColorBlue(_, c) chooseColor(c, "Blue") end

function onChat(message, player)
    local msg = string.lower((message or ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))
    if msg == "!start" then if isHost(player.color) then startRound(player.color) end return false end
    if msg == "!uno" then callUno(player.color) return false end
    if msg == "!challenge" then challengeW4(player.color) return false end
    if msg == "!accept" then acceptW4(player.color) return false end
    if msg == "!draw" then drawAction(player.color) return false end
    local c = msg:match("^!color%s+(%a+)$")
    if c then chooseColor(player.color, normUnoColor(c)) return false end
    local t = msg:match("^!catch%s*(%a*)$")
    if t ~= nil then catchUno(player.color, normPlayerColor(t)) return false end
    return true
end

function startRound(starter)
    resetState()
    local active = seatedPlayers()
    if #active < 2 then
        broadcastToAll("Need at least 2 seated players.", {1,0.4,0.4})
        return
    end
    STATE.players = sortByOrder(active)
    for i,c in ipairs(STATE.players) do STATE.idx[c] = i end

    cleanupOldPiles()
    local draw = ensureDrawPile()
    if not draw then
        broadcastToAll("Could not create draw pile.", {1,0.4,0.4})
        return
    end
    draw.setName("UNO Draw Pile")
    draw.setLock(true)
    draw.randomize()
    STATE.draw_guid = draw.getGUID()

    local dealer = normPlayerColor(starter) or STATE.players[1]
    local start_idx = wrap((STATE.idx[dealer] or 1) + 1)

    for r=1,7 do
        for s=0,#STATE.players-1 do
            drawToPlayer(STATE.players[wrap(start_idx+s)], 1)
        end
    end

    Wait.time(function()
        local first = takeOne()
        if not first then return end
        placeDiscard(first)
        local meta = parseMeta(first)
        if not meta then return end

        STATE.active = true
        applyStartup(meta, first, dealer, start_idx)
        setTurn(STATE.turn)
        broadcastToAll("UNO started. Turn: " .. STATE.turn, {0.5,0.9,0.5})
    end, 1.0)
end

function resetState()
    STATE.active = false
    STATE.winner = nil
    STATE.players = {}
    STATE.idx = {}
    STATE.dir = 1
    STATE.turn = nil
    STATE.turn_no = 0
    STATE.draw_guid = nil
    STATE.top_guid = nil
    STATE.top_color = nil
    STATE.top_type = nil
    STATE.top_value = nil
    STATE.discard_n = 0
    STATE.awaiting_color = nil
    STATE.pending_w4 = nil
    STATE.pending_uno = {}
    STATE.catch_window = nil
    STATE.drew = false
end

function applyStartup(meta, card, dealer, start_idx)
    setTop(meta, card)
    local idx = start_idx
    if meta.type == "wild_draw_four" then
        local pile = drawPile()
        if pile then pile.putObject(card) pile.randomize() end
        local r = takeOne(); if r then placeDiscard(r); applyStartup(parseMeta(r), r, dealer, start_idx) end
        return
    elseif meta.type == "wild" then
        STATE.top_color = "Red"
    elseif meta.type == "skip" then
        idx = wrap(start_idx + 1)
    elseif meta.type == "reverse" then
        STATE.dir = -1
        idx = STATE.idx[dealer]
    elseif meta.type == "draw_two" then
        drawToPlayer(STATE.players[start_idx], 2)
        idx = wrap(start_idx + 1)
    end
    STATE.turn = STATE.players[idx]
end

function ensureDrawPile()
    if SETTINGS.existing_draw_guid then
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(SETTINGS.existing_draw_guid)
        if o then return o end
    end
    for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if o and o.getName() == "UNO Draw Pile" then return o end
    end
    return spawnDeck()
end

function spawnDeck()
    local cards = buildCards()
    local data = {
        Name="DeckCustom", Nickname="UNO Draw Pile", Description="uno_draw_pile",
        Transform={posX=SETTINGS.draw_pos.x,posY=SETTINGS.draw_pos.y,posZ=SETTINGS.draw_pos.z,rotX=0,rotY=180,rotZ=180,scaleX=1,scaleY=1,scaleZ=1},
        Locked=true, Snap=true,
        DeckIDs={},
        CustomDeck={},
        ContainedObjects={}
    }
    for i,m in ipairs(cards) do
        local id = i * 100
        local key = tostring(i)
        data.CustomDeck[key] = {
            FaceURL = faceUrlForCard(m),
            BackURL = SETTINGS.back,
            NumWidth = 1,
            NumHeight = 1,
            BackIsHidden = true,
            UniqueBack = false,
            Type = 0
        }
        table.insert(data.DeckIDs, id)
        table.insert(data.ContainedObjects, {
            Name="Card", Nickname=m.label, Description=m.code .. "\n" .. m.label, CardID=id,
            Tags={"uno", string.lower(m.color), m.type, tostring(m.rank)},
            Transform={posX=0,posY=0,posZ=0,rotX=0,rotY=180,rotZ=180,scaleX=1,scaleY=1,scaleZ=1}
        })
    end
    return spawnObjectData({data=data})
end

function buildCards()
    local out, cols = {}, {"Red","Yellow","Green","Blue"}
    for _,c in ipairs(cols) do
        push(out, c, "number", "0", 0, c.." 0")
        for n=1,9 do push(out,c,"number",tostring(n),n,c.." "..n); push(out,c,"number",tostring(n),n,c.." "..n) end
        for i=1,2 do
            push(out,c,"skip","skip",nil,c.." Skip")
            push(out,c,"reverse","reverse",nil,c.." Reverse")
            push(out,c,"draw_two","draw_two",nil,c.." Draw Two")
        end
    end
    for i=1,4 do
        push(out,"Wild","wild","wild",nil,"Wild")
        push(out,"Wild","wild_draw_four","wild_draw_four",nil,"Wild Draw Four")
    end
    return out
end

function push(t,c,ty,r,v,l)
    table.insert(t, {label=l, code=string.lower(c).."|"..ty.."|"..tostring(r), color=c, type=ty, rank=r, value=v})
end

function faceUrlForCard(card)
    local bg = "f5f5f5"
    local fg = "111111"
    if card.color == "Red" then bg, fg = "d32f2f", "ffffff" end
    if card.color == "Yellow" then bg, fg = "f9a825", "111111" end
    if card.color == "Green" then bg, fg = "2e7d32", "ffffff" end
    if card.color == "Blue" then bg, fg = "1565c0", "ffffff" end
    if card.color == "Wild" then bg, fg = "212121", "ffffff" end
    local text = urlEncode(card.label)
    return "https://dummyimage.com/750x1050/" .. bg .. "/" .. fg .. ".png&text=" .. text
end

function urlEncode(value)
    local s = tostring(value or "")
    s = string.gsub(s, "%%", "%%25")
    s = string.gsub(s, "%+", "%%2B")
    s = string.gsub(s, "/", "%%2F")
    s = string.gsub(s, " ", "+")
    return s
end

function onObjectDrop(player_color, object)
    if not STATE.active or STATE.winner or not object or object.tag ~= "Card" then return end
    if not nearDiscard(object.getPosition()) then return end
    if player_color ~= STATE.turn then return bounce(player_color, object, "Not your turn.") end
    if STATE.awaiting_color then return bounce(player_color, object, "Pick Wild color first.") end
    if STATE.pending_w4 then return bounce(player_color, object, "Resolve Draw Four first.") end

    local meta = parseMeta(object)
    if not meta then return bounce(player_color, object, "Invalid UNO card metadata.") end
    local ok, why = legal(meta, player_color)
    if not ok then return bounce(player_color, object, why) end

    local prev_color = STATE.top_color
    placeDiscard(object)
    setTop(meta, object)
    afterPlay(player_color, meta, prev_color)
    maybeUno(player_color)
    maybeWin(player_color)
end

function afterPlay(player, meta, prev_color)
    if meta.type == "wild" or meta.type == "wild_draw_four" then
        STATE.awaiting_color = { player = player, ctype = meta.type, pre = prev_color }
        STATE.top_color = nil
        broadcastToAll(player .. " played " .. meta.label .. ". Choose a color.", {0.9,0.9,0.3})
        return
    end
    if meta.type == "draw_two" then
        local t = nextPlayer(player, 1)
        drawToPlayer(t, 2)
        return setTurn(nextPlayer(player, 2))
    end
    if meta.type == "skip" then return setTurn(nextPlayer(player, 2)) end
    if meta.type == "reverse" then STATE.dir = STATE.dir * -1; return setTurn(nextPlayer(player, 1)) end
    setTurn(nextPlayer(player, 1))
end

function chooseColor(player_color, color)
    if not STATE.awaiting_color then return end
    if STATE.awaiting_color.player ~= player_color then return end
    color = normUnoColor(color)
    if not color then return end
    local typ, pre = STATE.awaiting_color.ctype, STATE.awaiting_color.pre
    STATE.awaiting_color = nil
    STATE.top_color = color
    broadcastToAll(player_color .. " chose " .. color .. ".", rgb(color))
    if typ == "wild_draw_four" then
        local t = nextPlayer(player_color, 1)
        STATE.pending_w4 = { offender = player_color, target = t, pre = pre }
        STATE.turn = t
        setTurns()
        Turns.turn_color = t
        broadcastToAll(t .. ": Challenge +4 or Accept +4.", {0.9,0.8,0.2})
    else
        setTurn(nextPlayer(player_color, 1))
    end
end

function challengeW4(player_color)
    local p = STATE.pending_w4
    if not p or p.target ~= player_color then return end
    if handHasColor(p.offender, p.pre) then
        drawToPlayer(p.offender, 4)
        STATE.pending_w4 = nil
        setTurn(player_color)
    else
        drawToPlayer(player_color, 6)
        STATE.pending_w4 = nil
        setTurn(nextPlayer(player_color, 1))
    end
end

function acceptW4(player_color)
    local p = STATE.pending_w4
    if not p or p.target ~= player_color then return end
    drawToPlayer(player_color, 4)
    STATE.pending_w4 = nil
    setTurn(nextPlayer(player_color, 1))
end

function drawAction(player_color)
    if not STATE.active or STATE.winner or player_color ~= STATE.turn then return end
    if STATE.awaiting_color or STATE.pending_w4 then return end
    if STATE.drew then return end
    drawToPlayer(player_color, 1)
    STATE.drew = true
    setTurn(nextPlayer(player_color, 1))
end

function legal(meta, player_color)
    if meta.type == "wild" then return true end
    if meta.type == "wild_draw_four" then
        if handHasColor(player_color, STATE.top_color) then return false, "Wild Draw Four illegal: matching color exists." end
        return true
    end
    if meta.color == STATE.top_color then return true end
    if meta.type ~= "number" and meta.type == STATE.top_type then return true end
    if meta.type == "number" and STATE.top_type == "number" and meta.value == STATE.top_value then return true end
    return false, "Must match color, number, or symbol."
end

function callUno(player_color)
    if STATE.pending_uno[player_color] then
        STATE.pending_uno[player_color] = nil
        broadcastToAll(player_color .. " called UNO!", {1,0.5,0.1})
    end
end

function maybeUno(player_color)
    Wait.time(function()
        if handCount(player_color) == 1 then
            STATE.pending_uno[player_color] = true
            STATE.catch_window = { offender = player_color, turn = STATE.turn_no }
        else
            STATE.pending_uno[player_color] = nil
        end
    end, 0.2)
end

function catchUno(caller, target)
    if not STATE.catch_window then return end
    local off = target or STATE.catch_window.offender
    if off ~= STATE.catch_window.offender or not STATE.pending_uno[off] then return end
    drawToPlayer(off, 2)
    STATE.pending_uno[off] = nil
    STATE.catch_window = nil
    broadcastToAll(caller .. " caught " .. off .. " for missed UNO.", {1,0.5,0.5})
end

function maybeWin(player_color)
    Wait.time(function()
        if STATE.winner or not STATE.active then return end
        if handCount(player_color) == 0 then
            STATE.winner = player_color
            STATE.active = false
            broadcastToAll(player_color .. " wins. Flipping table...", {1,0.8,0.2})
            flipTable()
        end
    end, 0.3)
end

function bounce(player_color, object, reason)
    broadcastToColor(reason, player_color, {1,0.5,0.5})
    local t = handTf(player_color)
    if t then
        object.setPositionSmooth({t.position[1], t.position[2]+2, t.position[3]}, false, true)
        object.setRotationSmooth({0, t.rotation[2], 0}, false, true)
    end
end

function setTop(meta, card)
    STATE.top_guid = card.getGUID()
    STATE.top_color = meta.color
    STATE.top_type = meta.type
    STATE.top_value = meta.value
end

function setTurn(color)
    STATE.turn = color
    STATE.turn_no = STATE.turn_no + 1
    STATE.drew = false
    setTurns()
    Turns.turn_color = color
    if STATE.catch_window and STATE.turn_no > STATE.catch_window.turn + 1 then STATE.catch_window = nil end
    broadcastToAll("Turn: " .. color, rgb(color))
end

function setTurns()
    Turns.enable = true
    Turns.type = 2
    Turns.order = STATE.players
    Turns.reverse_order = (STATE.dir == -1)
    Turns.pass_turns = false
    Turns.skip_empty_hands = false
end

function drawToPlayer(color, count)
    for i=1,count do
        local card = takeOne()
        if not card then return end
        local t = handTf(color)
        if t then
            card.setPositionSmooth({t.position[1], t.position[2]+2, t.position[3]}, false, true)
            card.setRotationSmooth({0, t.rotation[2], 0}, false, true)
        end
    end
end

function takeOne()
    local pile = drawPile()
    if not pile then reshuffleDiscard(); pile = drawPile(); if not pile then return nil end end
    if pile.tag == "Deck" then return pile.takeObject({position={SETTINGS.draw_pos.x+0.6, SETTINGS.draw_pos.y+1.5, SETTINGS.draw_pos.z}, smooth=false}) end
    if pile.tag == "Card" then STATE.draw_guid = nil; return pile end
    return nil
end

function drawPile()
    if STATE.draw_guid then
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(STATE.draw_guid)
        if o then return o end
    end
    local best, bestd = nil, 99
    for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if o and (o.tag == "Deck" or o.tag == "Card") then
            local d = d2(o.getPosition(), SETTINGS.draw_pos)
            if d < bestd and d < 3 then best, bestd = o, d end
        end
    end
    if best then STATE.draw_guid = best.getGUID() end
    return best
end

function reshuffleDiscard()
    local top = STATE.top_guid
    local cards = {}
    for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if o and o.tag == "Card" and o.getGUID() ~= top and nearDiscard(o.getPosition()) then table.insert(cards, o) end
    end
    if #cards == 0 then return end
    for i,o in ipairs(cards) do
        o.setPositionSmooth({SETTINGS.draw_pos.x, SETTINGS.draw_pos.y+1+i*0.02, SETTINGS.draw_pos.z}, false, true)
        o.setRotationSmooth({0,180,180}, false, true)
    end
    Wait.time(function()
        local p = drawPile()
        if p then p.setName("UNO Draw Pile") p.randomize() p.setLock(true) STATE.draw_guid = p.getGUID() end
    end, 0.8)
end

function placeDiscard(card)
    STATE.discard_n = STATE.discard_n + 1
    local y = SETTINGS.discard_pos.y + STATE.discard_n * SETTINGS.discard_step
    card.setPositionSmooth({SETTINGS.discard_pos.x, y, SETTINGS.discard_pos.z}, false, true)
    card.setRotationSmooth({0,180,0}, false, true)
end

function parseMeta(card)
    local desc = (card.getDescription() or ""):lower()
    local name = card.getName() or ""
    local c,t,r = desc:match("([a-z]+)|([a-z_]+)|([a-z0-9_]*)")
    if c and t then
        local col = normUnoColor(c)
        if t == "wild" or t == "wild_draw_four" then col = "Wild" end
        return { color=col, type=t, rank=r, value=tonumber(r), label=name }
    end
    local ln = name:lower()
    local col = nil
    if ln:find("red") then col = "Red" elseif ln:find("yellow") then col = "Yellow" elseif ln:find("green") then col = "Green" elseif ln:find("blue") then col = "Blue" elseif ln:find("wild") then col = "Wild" end
    if not col then return nil end
    if ln:find("draw four") then return {color="Wild",type="wild_draw_four",label=name} end
    if ln:find("wild") then return {color="Wild",type="wild",label=name} end
    if ln:find("draw two") then return {color=col,type="draw_two",label=name} end
    if ln:find("reverse") then return {color=col,type="reverse",label=name} end
    if ln:find("skip") then return {color=col,type="skip",label=name} end
    local n = tonumber(ln:match("(%d)")); if n then return {color=col,type="number",value=n,label=name} end
    return nil
end

function handHasColor(color, uno_color)
    if not uno_color or uno_color == "Wild" then return false end
    for _,o in ipairs(handObjs(color)) do
        local m = parseMeta(o)
        if m and m.color == uno_color then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function handCount(color) return #handObjs(color) end
function handObjs(color) local p=Player[color]; if not p then return {} end local ok,v=pcall(function() return p.getHandObjects() end); return (ok and v) and v or {} end
function handTf(color) local p=Player[color]; if not p then return nil end local ok,v=pcall(function() return p.getHandTransform(1) end); return (ok and v) and v or nil end

function seatedPlayers()
    local out = {}
    for _,p in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do if p.seated and p.color ~= "Black" and p.color ~= "Grey" then table.insert(out, p.color) end end
    return out
end

function sortByOrder(colors)
    local map = {}; for i,c in ipairs(SETTINGS.player_order) do map[c]=i end
    table.sort(colors, function(a,b) return (map[a] or 999) < (map[b] or 999) end)
    return colors
end

function nextPlayer(from, steps)
    local i = STATE.idx[from] or 1
    return STATE.players[wrap(i + (steps or 1) * STATE.dir)]
end

function wrap(i)
    local n = #STATE.players
    while i < 1 do i = i + n end
    while i > n do i = i - n end
    return i
end

function nearDiscard(pos) return d2(pos, SETTINGS.discard_pos) <= SETTINGS.discard_radius end
function d2(a,b) local dx=(a.x or a[1]) - b.x; local dz=(a.z or a[3]) - b.z; return math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz) end

function cleanupOldPiles()
    for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if o then
            local name = o.getName() or ""
            local desc = o.getDescription() or ""
            if name == "UNO Draw Pile"
                or desc == "uno_draw_pile"
                or string.find(desc, "|", 1, true)
                or hasTag(o, "uno") then
                o.destruct()
            end
        end
    end
end

function hasTag(obj, wanted)
    local ok, tags = pcall(function() return obj.getTags() end)
    if not ok or not tags then return false end
    for _, t in ipairs(tags) do
        if t == wanted then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function normUnoColor(raw)
    if not raw then return nil end
    local s = tostring(raw):lower()
    if s=="r" or s=="red" then return "Red" end
    if s=="y" or s=="yellow" then return "Yellow" end
    if s=="g" or s=="green" then return "Green" end
    if s=="b" or s=="blue" then return "Blue" end
    if s=="wild" then return "Wild" end
    return nil
end

function normPlayerColor(raw)
    if not raw or raw == "" then return nil end
    local s = tostring(raw):lower()
    for _,c in ipairs(SETTINGS.player_order) do if c:lower() == s then return c end end
    return nil
end

function rgb(name)
    local n = normUnoColor(name) or normPlayerColor(name) or name
    if n == "Red" then return {0.85,0.15,0.15} end
    if n == "Yellow" then return {0.92,0.82,0.12} end
    if n == "Green" then return {0.18,0.65,0.25} end
    if n == "Blue" then return {0.18,0.35,0.86} end
    return {0.9,0.9,0.9}
end

function isHost(color)
    if color == "Black" then return true end
    local p = Player[color]
    return p and p.host == true
end
